entries.title: Kugel Tennis VR
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Wii-Tennis for VR: swing your controller like a racket vs a CPU Kugel. Auto-run to the ball, aim by swinging across, real tennis scoring. Kompass VR / WebXR; mouse on a screen.

entries.title: Kugel Gorillas VR
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Gorilla-Tag-style arm locomotion: push off the ground, rocks and trees with your hands to run, jump and climb. You're IT: tag all 4 gorillas. Best time saved. Keyboard on a screen.

entries.title: Kugel Saber VR
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Beat-Saber-style: slice red blocks left and blue blocks right, the way the arrows point. Avoid bombs, build combos up to 8x. Best score saved. Mouse on a screen.
